rationale: Test recovery after a pullback within an already aligned uptrend rather than entering the first EMA crossover. This is an unproven hypothesis.
entry: After 600 closed hourly candles: prior and current EMA20>EMA50>EMA200; prior close<=prior EMA20; current close>current EMA20; current close>current open; ATR14/close in [0.001,0.02]. Enter only next hourly open.
exit: One full exit; stop before target if OHLC touches both; next-open gaps can exceed estimated risk. No partial exits or averaging down.
stress: Double both fee and slippage; retain exchange precision and minimum-order constraints.
historical_protocol: Same previously inspected sample, continuous run and four sequential blocks with warmup, base and doubled costs. No parameter search after results.
rejection: Reject if base net<=0, fewer than three positive base blocks, open/blocked inventory, drawdown latch, or stress net<=0. Passing remains preliminary, never execution authorization.
forward_protocol: Only after historical screening: separately identified paper session, 20 USDT total, at least 30 calendar days and 30 closed cycles, whichever is later; do not reset balances, alter parameters or extend automatically. Insufficient samples remain inconclusive. Separate authorization required to create that session.
